title: A contact of a customer that no longer pays is refused as Authorizer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with two contacts, contact B1 and contact B2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, expand the Customer card.
  2. In the first tab, click the Authorizer field.
  3. Switch to the second tab.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
  5. Click the Bill To field.
  6. Pick customer C in the list.
  7. Switch to the first tab.
  8. Pick contact B1 in the Authorizer list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 2:

  • Contact B1 is offered.

Step 3:

  • The second tab shows work order 1 for customer A.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • The list opens.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 7:

  • The first tab still shows the open Authorizer list.

Step 8:

  • The pick is refused, as a contact of any other customer is refused today.
  • After a reload, Authorizer does not show contact B1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
